host_header_validation.behavior: Host headers not matching _TRUSTED_LOCAL_HOSTS are rejected with 403 Forbidden to prevent DNS rebinding attacks.

origin_header_validation.behavior: Cross-origin requests from untrusted origins are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

null_origin_rejection.behavior: Requests presenting Origin: null (such as sandboxed iframes or file: URI) are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

missing_origin_handling.behavior: Missing Origin is allowed only when direct TCP client.host and Host/Forwarded headers resolve to trusted local addresses (safe CLI / local automation boundary; browsers cannot omit Origin on cross-site mutations).

x_forwarded_host_validation.behavior: X-Forwarded-Host headers matching untrusted external domains are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

x_forwarded_for_validation.behavior: Any external IP address present in X-Forwarded-For (single or multi-hop) is rejected with 403 Forbidden. Local loopback proxy hops are permitted.

remote_client_ip_rejection.behavior: Non-local direct socket callers (client.host not in _TRUSTED_LOCAL_HOSTS) are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

feature_gate_enforcement.behavior: Agent cycle mutation is rejected with 403 Forbidden when agent_execution_enabled is False (default configuration).

task_id_mismatch_protection.behavior: Requests where URL query task_id differs from body payload task_id are rejected with 409 Conflict.
